title: Registry tier tables of the human shotgun-metagenome catalog (SCALE_UP_PLAN §2.2; docs/EXPANSION.md)

evidence_row.source: labelled source (study.title | study.description | sample.title | sample.attr.<key> | run.<field> | external_curation.<source>)

registry_studies.parquet.one_row_per: ENA study in the registry universe

columns.name: description_short
columns.description: ENA study description truncated to 300 characters

columns.name: n_runs
columns.description: Runs in the registry universe for this study

columns.name: n_runs_sandpiper
columns.description: Runs of the study with a Sandpiper (SingleM) community profile in the pinned Sandpiper snapshot (config Makefile SANDPIPER_VERSION / ZENODO_RECORD); 0 when the join table was not supplied

columns.name: scientific_names_top
columns.description: ';'-joined top-5 scientific_name values with run counts, e.g. 'human gut metagenome (120)'

columns.name: host_evidence
columns.description: JSON list of {source, quote} (quote ≤ 12 words; source from the curation-skill label list)

columns.name: body_site_primary
columns.description: Primary body-site code (multi_site when ≥ 3 strong sites)

columns.name: life_stage_primary
columns.description: Primary life-stage code (mixed_ages when ≥ 3 strong stages)

columns.name: classification_stage
columns.description: Cascade stage that produced the classification

columns.name: classification_model
columns.description: 'deterministic' or the resolved model id of the deciding stage

columns.name: infant_reason_code
columns.description: Infant triage reason_code (curation-skill vocabulary) or null

columns.name: universe_slice
columns.description: Enumeration slice that found the study

columns.name: n_biosamples_harvested
columns.description: BioSamples of the study with a harvested attribute record (registry_biosamples); 0 = not harvested

columns.name: n_biosamples_with_site
columns.description: Harvested BioSamples with a body-site code other than unknown_site

columns.name: n_biosamples_with_age
columns.description: Harvested BioSamples with a life stage other than unknown_age

columns.name: sample_body_sites
columns.description: JSON dict body_site_code → BioSample count (from registry_biosamples)

columns.name: sample_countries
columns.description: JSON dict ISO-3166 alpha-2 → BioSample count (top 5)

columns.name: sample_age_days_median
columns.description: Median age_days over harvested BioSamples with a numeric age

columns.name: release_added
columns.description: Bitemporal: release id in which the row first appeared

columns.name: release_retired
columns.description: Bitemporal: release id in which the row was retired; null = current

columns.name: package_added
columns.description: Bitemporal: package semver of first appearance

registry_studies.parquet.bitemporal: release columns appended at the end in releases.yaml order; built_with_release_columns: true

registry_runs.parquet.one_row_per: ENA read_run in the registry universe
registry_runs.parquet.storage: single working_data artifact (≈1.5M rows); columns restricted to the pull fields

columns.name: found_by
columns.description: Enumeration slice tag that pulled the run

columns.name: ena_count
columns.description: Count returned by the ENA count endpoint

registry_biosamples.parquet.one_row_per: harvested BioSample of a registry study (S2: human_all studies outside the curated infant catalog)

columns.name: sample_accession
columns.description: BioSample accession (SAMN/SAME/SAMD) as listed in registry_biosample_index; primary key

columns.name: study_accession
columns.description: ENA study (BioProject) the sample belongs to

columns.name: n_attributes
columns.description: Non-placeholder attribute rows harvested for the sample

columns.name: source
columns.description: ena_xml | ncbi_biosample — where the attribute record came from

columns.name: body_site_code
columns.description: config/vocab/body_sites.yaml code from the normalised body-site attribute; unknown_site when an attribute existed but mapped to no site; null when no body-site attribute

columns.name: body_site_raw_key
columns.description: Normalised attribute key the code came from (e.g. host_body_site, isolation_source)

columns.name: body_site_raw_value
columns.description: Raw attribute value the code came from

columns.name: life_stage
columns.description: config/vocab/life_stages.yaml code from the age attribute (or from age_days); unknown_age when an age attribute existed but was not interpretable; null when none

columns.name: age_days
columns.description: Age at collection in days when a numeric age with unit was given

columns.name: age_raw_key
columns.description: Attribute key the age came from

columns.name: sex
columns.description: female | male | unknown; null when no sex attribute

columns.name: sex_raw_key
columns.description: Attribute key the sex came from

columns.name: country_iso2
columns.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 from geo_loc_name / country attributes

columns.name: country_raw_key
columns.description: Attribute key the country came from

columns.name: disease_raw
columns.description: First non-placeholder disease/health/phenotype attribute value (≤200 chars; NOT normalised — no controlled vocabulary yet)

columns.name: release_added
columns.description: Release id in which the row first appeared

columns.name: release_retired
columns.description: Release id in which the row was retired (null = current)

columns.name: package_added
columns.description: Package version that first carried the row

registry_biosamples.parquet.bitemporal: release columns written by build_biosamples; normalisation map = utility-model pass over distinct (key,value) pairs (docs/REGISTRY_S2_PILOT.md, config/budgets.yaml registry_s2)

registry_study_papers.parquet.one_row_per: study × linked paper (accession mention in Europe PMC and/or publication declared in the NCBI BioProject record); 4,217 human_all studies outside the curated infant catalog

columns.name: paper_id
columns.description: Europe PMC id (MED:<pmid> | PMC… | PPR… | DOI:…); part of the key

columns.name: pmid
columns.description: PubMed id of the linked paper

columns.name: in_epmc_fulltext
columns.description: Full text available in Europe PMC

columns.name: source
columns.description: europepmc_mention | bioproject_xml | both — how the paper was linked

columns.name: match_field
columns.description: abstract_or_title | fulltext_only — where the accession was mentioned

columns.name: match_accession
columns.description: Accession matched (primary PRJ… or secondary ERP/SRP/DRP)

columns.name: bioproject_declared
columns.description: Paper is listed as a publication in the NCBI BioProject record

columns.name: n_registry_studies
columns.description: How many processed registry studies this paper mentions

columns.name: relation
columns.description: data_paper | related | unsure — deterministic link class (see REGISTRY_S2_PAPERS.md §2.3)

columns.name: method
columns.description: Rule that produced the relation (det_bioproject_declared 0.9, det_single_mention_abstract 0.75, det_single_mention_fulltext 0.6)

columns.name: contested
columns.description: True when the paper mentions ≥ 2 processed studies

columns.name: epmc_rank
columns.description: Rank of the paper in the Europe PMC hit list for the study

columns.name: epmc_hit_count
columns.description: Europe PMC hitCount for the study query

columns.name: epmc_hits_capped
columns.description: Hit list truncated at 300 (never true in R2026.5)

columns.name: release_added
columns.description: Release id in which the row first appeared

columns.name: release_retired
columns.description: Release id in which the row was retired (null = current)

columns.name: package_added
columns.description: Package version that first carried the row

registry_study_papers.parquet.bitemporal: release columns appended by catalog.registry.add_registry_tables (harvest 2026-09-27, docs/REGISTRY_S2_PAPERS.md)

columns.name: organizations_json
columns.description: JSON list of organisations (name, abbr, role)

columns.name: release_added
columns.description: Release id in which the row first appeared

columns.name: release_retired
columns.description: Release id in which the row was retired (null = current)

columns.name: package_added
columns.description: Package version that first carried the row

registry_bioproject_records.parquet.bitemporal: release columns appended by catalog.registry.add_registry_tables (harvest 2026-09-27, docs/REGISTRY_S2_PAPERS.md)

registry_authors.parquet.one_row_per: study × paper × author (Europe PMC core records of ≤ 5 linked papers per study)

columns.name: source
columns.description: europepmc_mention | bioproject_xml | both — how the paper was linked

columns.name: pmid
columns.description: PubMed id of the linked paper

columns.name: position
columns.description: Author position (1 = first); part of the key

columns.name: affiliation
columns.description: Affiliation string (e-mail addresses removed, rule F7)

columns.name: author_key
columns.description: lower-case surname + initials key for de-duplication

columns.name: release_added
columns.description: Release id in which the row first appeared

columns.name: release_retired
columns.description: Release id in which the row was retired (null = current)

columns.name: package_added
columns.description: Package version that first carried the row

registry_authors.parquet.bitemporal: release columns appended by catalog.registry.add_registry_tables (harvest 2026-09-27, docs/REGISTRY_S2_PAPERS.md)
